title: Spatial listener selection, transforms and lifetime
scope: 88 complete native bodies,4064 instructions,16934 original bytes verified. Research only; frozen Trainer0.9 unchanged.
conclusions: Active listener is the last enabled entry with maximal unsigned priority; kind1/base,2/point,3/line are distinct native classes.
Cached listener position is manager+132, subject to valid selected membership and last native update; raw nonnull selected pointer is insufficient after list changes.
Native calls may allocate/delete, consume reverb requests, or notify callbacks. A diagnostic snapshot should directly copy validated fields under existing lock/lifetime constraints.
071940/50/60 are concrete false-return stubs, not missing callable developer tools.
Disabling/deleting every listener is unsuitable:072070 includes a null dereference when both previous/current selected pointers are null.
Only three direct root writes were found among34 supplied IDA xrefs: one publication and two cleanup clears; this does not exclude computed/external writes.

diagnostic_contract.status: Read-only contract independently reviewed statically; implementation pending.
diagnostic_contract.thread: Reuse existing audio_mix ThreadReady and successful GraphReady on the validated application post-Update engine thread. Existing audio_lifecycle report supplies initialization/shutdown serialization.
diagnostic_contract.locks: Acquire global Sound CS2B81278 with TryEnter first, validate roots, then TryEnter manager CS+776 only after manager range/vtable/byte816 validation and the independent post-Update lifetime gate. Byte816 alone is not a lifetime witness:070E20 deletes the CS without clearing it. Retain both during list/selected/matrix copies; release the captured acquired manager CS before the captured global CS in guaranteed cleanup. Never wait for a lock or call native getters.
diagnostic_contract.graph: Manager global2B81DF8 readable992B, vtable61A3E0, initialized byte816==1; layout global2B81DE8 readable1440B/vtable619DE8; manager+8==layout and layout+8==manager. Driver graph stays the existing verified graph. Recheck same roots under the locks.
diagnostic_contract.members: Count+24 must be0..capacity, capacity+32 in1..1024 (trainer bound), highwater+28 between count and capacity. Validate full pointer array capacity*8 and each counted nonnull unique pointer/ID. DWORD IDs+12 nonzero, QWORD backlink+16==manager, BYTE kind+8 and vtable must form a known pair (base61A780/1,point61A8D8/2,line61A998/3), range136B for base/point or184B for line. Delete-ID071640 and Delete-All071740 leave selected+120 unchanged. No dereference of selected+120 until it equals a validated list member.
diagnostic_contract.freshness: Selected must be registered, enabled and equal to the last maximal unsigned-priority enabled member for active readouts. Structural/readiness counts may still be available without selected. Cached transform must be finite but may precede the newest controller setter; label as last native audio update. Do not recompute the inverse, invoke update or expose unverified manager+148 as velocity.
diagnostic_contract.deferred: Speaker-mode/channel configuration, gain/envelope controls, listener overrides and object creation remain research only. Slots419..423 stay reserved but unused until actual behavior and user value are clear.
limitations: The graph can change immediately after unlock.
A valid member may have a newer matrix than the cached manager position; there is no dedicated frame stamp.
External mods invoking private audio teardown from other threads are outside the observed native lifecycle.
Pointer reuse and arbitrary corrupt memory cannot be proved away by structural checks.
